svg.title: Diffusion: training versus generation
svg.desc: Training learns a noise estimate. Generation reuses a denoiser and scheduler. Four schematic house panels show changing states, not real model output.
svg.text: Diffusion: what is learned, and what changes during sampling
Clean image + sampled noise + timestep → noisy example → denoiser
Compare predicted noise with sampled noise; update the network weights.
GENERATION · prompt example: “a blue house with a red roof”
Schematic pixels only — not model samples or a guaranteed order of features.
ONE SAMPLING UPDATE · reused at each remaining timestep
Repeat until the schedule finishes; this is not a new model per step.
Latent diffusion: apply these updates to latents, then decode to pixels at the end.
